global_reception_faqs.answer: Use the business's approved hours configured in its tenant profile. If those hours are unavailable, ask the caller whether they would like a callback.
Use the business's approved address configured in its tenant profile. Do not invent a location.

questions: Do you offer home blood collection?
Ghar se sample collection hota hai kya?
faqs.answer: Confirm home collection availability, service area, fee and timing from the tenant's live configuration before promising a collection.

questions: When will my report be ready?
faqs.answer: Check the test-specific report turnaround configured by the diagnostic centre. Do not promise a generic report time.

questions: Do I need to fast before a test?
Kya khali pet test karwana hoga?
faqs.answer: Do not give patient-specific preparation advice from a generic FAQ. Refer to the lab's approved test-preparation instructions or transfer to qualified lab staff.

questions: Mujhe property ke baare mein baat karni hai
faqs.answer: Offer to arrange a consultation with an authorized property advisor. Confirm current project, price, payment plan, eligibility and visa information from approved, current tenant materials before answering.
